title: Open involvement holds different feelings
meaning: Open shared action through a wish for mutuality is emotionally expressed through gradually combining different feelings and needs.
text: The Star in the physical position of this Energy Field describes open shared actions: you may share attention, show something important without demanding return and leave room for possibility. The Lovers in energy motivate seeking living mutuality and remaining turned towards each other. Temperance in emotions adds the experience of differences gradually coming together. An open action can be close in its motive while emotional coexistence is still developing. This requires no identical enthusiasm and promises no finished harmony: different feelings can find a common place without matching interests or pace completely.

For example, you show friends the beginning of a home film together. Wanting mutual involvement helps you offer it without expecting a particular assessment. One person is nervous while the other feels lively, but after viewing these feelings gradually stop obstructing being beside each other. **We share openly while our different responses still find room together.** Relief concerns emotional combination; it does not establish that everyone equally wants further showings or a larger amount of work. Different wishes can remain visible.

Combination becomes restrictive if it turns into a duty always to accept a midpoint. Openness remains outwardly intact while inconvenience is hidden for a calm picture. Temperance requires no endless compromise, and the Lovers make no identical feelings a condition of closeness. The Star in action permits possibility without guaranteed return and different involvement while you clarify what you are ready to show and at what pace to continue. The shared response can develop without becoming uniform.
